draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.69, the 216th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 17th of 20 at S. He lasted until pick 254, well after his grade rank (216th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 72 tackles in 2021, 5th of 19 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Chicago Bears. 61 career games and 15 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2023. Weak spots: passes defended 0 (8th percentile), season snap share 5.8% (9th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 safety who played: 5.8% season snap share against a median of 72.3%, below the norm.
